items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: So I told Ernie, 'Look, I'm headed to New York actually.' So he said, 'Well, that's perfect, because we're going to Washington, D.C., and you can work your way up with us...'

ctx.x: [LAUGHS] Yeah, that was a real big... At that same time Ernie Andrews had 'Soothe Me,' about the same period, when he was sixteen years old; he had a big one, 'Soothe Me.'
